name: BalancedTraders
title: Balanced Traders - Smooth Trophy Sell Prices (native port)
author: L-Sypniewski (native port). Original mod: Altos25
description: Hunting trophies never sell for 0 ore. Floors the sell value of zero-priced trophies (e.g. lizard claws, scavenger teeth) and arrows to a minimum of 1 ore at every trader, keeping the game's regional and per-trader dynamic pricing fully intact. Native AngelScript port of BalancedTraders by Altos25 (Nexus Mods #473, v1.0.2).
